successors.name: Yangshao culture
successors.text: Xinzheng and the Yi-Luo basin, the Peiligang country the Yangshao takes over

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the Peiligang millet villages hold the Yi-Luo basin and Xinzheng in Henan (the culture "existed from about 7000 to 5000 BC", so it began before the project's first year); Jiahu lies "several days' travel to the south".
5700 BCE: Jiahu, the southern outlier, is abandoned: "Settled c.
5000 BCE: the Peiligang gives way to the Yangshao culture (infobox "7000-5000 BC", "Followed by: Yangshao culture"); the page gives no transition.

certainty.note: The culture area is known from sites (over 100 in about 100 km2 plus Jiahu); no border is recorded, so every edge is soft.
